title: Searching for Compact Obscured Nuclei in Compton-thick Active Galactic Nuclei
question: Are Compact Obscured Nuclei (CONs, bright HCN-vib cores) present in hard X-ray-confirmed Compton-thick AGN of GOALS U/LIRGs, and do CT AGN show evolved molecular outflows consistent with a CON-to-CT-AGN evolutionary sequence?

recipe.goal: Calibrate, continuum-subtract and image line cubes and continuum
recipe.method: Automated ALMA imaging pipeline continuum subtraction (NGC 6921 manual); Briggs-weighted imaging; cubes smoothed to ~33 km/s; continuum image from line-free channels
key_parameters: Cubes smoothed to ~33 km/s channels, about four times the pipeline products

recipe.goal: Measure 1-mm continuum peak positions, flux densities and sizes
recipe.method: Two-dimensional Gaussian fit to the continuum map with CASA IMFIT; two components for NGC 7130
key_parameters: Fit region contains all continuum emission >3 sigma
NGC 7130 two-component fit with peak positions fixed to observed peaks
assumptions: 1-mm continuum peak taken as the AGN position (and spectral extraction position)

recipe.goal: Make moment 0 maps and measure HCN and HCO+ (3-2) line fluxes, FWHM and surface brightness at the continuum peak
recipe.method: Beam-sized aperture spectra at the continuum peak; Gaussian FWHM via specutils; flux over twice the FWHM; luminosity from Solomon and Vanden Bout formula divided by aperture area
key_parameters: Moment 0 integrated over all channels with >3 sigma line emission
Flux integrated over a velocity range of twice the Gaussian FWHM
Flux uncertainty from spectrum RMS plus an assumed 10% Band 6 flux uncertainty
assumptions: Rest frequencies from Splatalogue; D_L and z from Armus et al. 2009

recipe.goal: Place 3-sigma upper limits on HCN-vib luminosity and surface brightness
recipe.method: Boxcar line profile of width equal to the HCN (3-2) FWHM on central beam spectrum, converted with the luminosity equation and divided by beam area
key_parameters: Example NGC 4922N: mean 1-sigma noise 0.25 mJy over FWHM 148 km/s gives <0.11 Jy km/s

recipe.goal: Search for non-circular motions: moment 1/2 maps and position-velocity diagrams
recipe.method: Moment 1 and 2 maps masked at moment 0 >= 3 sigma; HCN (3-2) PV slices along the major axis through the continuum peak
key_parameters: PV slice width about one beam
Systemic velocity from the peak of the HCN (3-2) line in extracted spectra

recipe.goal: Map HCN/HCO+ (3-2) luminosity ratio and extract spectra at HCN-enhanced regions for outflow wings
recipe.method: Ratio of HCN and HCO+ moment 0 maps masked where HCN is below 3 sigma; beam-sized spectra at elevated-ratio positions
assumptions: Elevated HCN/HCO+ can be driven by mechanical heating from outflows

recipe.goal: Compare CT AGN HCN-vib and 1-mm surface brightness with CONs and derive CON detection rate
recipe.method: Re-measure HCN-vib upper limits with continuum-sized apertures, plot against S_1mm/Omega with literature CONs and U/LIRGs, compute detection-rate interval
key_parameters: 1-sigma confidence interval by beta distribution quantile technique
assumptions: Both continuum peaks of NGC 7130 plotted since the AGN position is unknown (10 points for 9 AGN)

recipe.goal: Test the effect of spatial resolution on the HCN-vib non-detections
recipe.method: Treat the HCN-vib emission as a point source with fixed luminosity (3-sigma or 1-sigma limit) and solve for the aperture radius at which surface brightness reaches 1 Lsun/pc^2
assumptions: Line luminosity constant; only aperture radius changes

recipe.goal: Assess outflow detectability and census literature outflows in the nine CT AGN
recipe.method: Scale line luminosities of known CON HCN outflows to the survey sensitivity; tally literature molecular outflows and ages

score_reason: Project code, CASA version, robust, channel width, lines, rest frequencies, and numeric tables are given, but line-free channels, imaging geometry, masks, apertures and PV axes are not, and data public status is not stated; literature inputs must be gathered separately.
rediscovery_reason: The single ALMA project (2017.1.00598.S) is from a 2017 cycle and should be in the public archive; flux, FWHM, upper-limit and surface-brightness values are tabulated so a redo of continuum, line fluxes and HCN-vib limits is feasible, although the data-public status is inferred rather than stated.
